insight.headline: New fields for cash
insight.what_changed: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. The CashDrawerBalance field and the cashCountActivities connection are now available. This change allows for more accurate tracking of cash management activities.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the GraphQL Admin API should update their queries to take advantage of the new fields. This change does not break any existing functionality, but it does provide more detailed information about cash management activities. Developers should review the updated API documentation to understand how to use the new fields. The new fields can be accessed using the GraphQL Admin API, specifically the CashDrawerBalance field and the cashCountActivities connection.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will have more accurate and detailed information about their cash management activities, which can help them better manage their finances.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it provides more detailed information about cash management activities, which can help merchants and developers better manage finances and track cash flow.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefront functionality, developer tools, and app requirements

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP support is available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores. Additionally, Oxygen is now available on development stores for Hydrogen storefront deployment.

themes.title: Developer Tools and APIs
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and the CLI has been updated to serve UI extension source maps during app development.

themes.title: App Requirements and Validation
themes.detail: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, with new thresholds that better reflect fulfillment operations in practice.
